name: Atlas Studio
summary: Near-black digital agency site with a red-orange liquid-gradient shader hero, a giant edge-to-edge wordmark, square-cornered cards and a staggered sticky process.

fonts.pairing: one grotesk at fractional weights (410 to 480) with very tight tracking, -0.06em on a 100px H1; bracketed caps labels

signature: liquid-gradient shader streaking red-orange across the black hero
agency name set as a full-width 108px wordmark below the hero fold
faint vertical grid lines framing the 50px gutters on every section
imagery: dark product mockups and device shots, monochrome team photography, square-cornered cards, red used as a block colour
layout_grid: 1300px canvas, 50px side padding with visible vertical guide lines, 0px radius cards, sections 600-2700px tall
